rules.rationale: This guarded base equation defines sequenceAcc to return the existing accumulator when the loop counter is already above the bound.
This guarded recurrence defines one concrete sequenceAcc step by appending a space and the decimal rendering of the current counter, incrementing the counter, and recurring.
This symbolic simplification rule repeats the exact base equation of sequenceAcc so that the defining base case is available during symbolic simplification; it adds no fact beyond that definition.

This proof-closing simplification folds an updated successor summary back to the preceding sequenceAcc call. It is the reverse-use consequence of the recurrence, but prove.sh never first proves this exact rule against a module that omits it, so it remains a trusted domain lemma.
This guarded equation defines stringSequenceCodes for negative inputs as the empty character-code sequence.
This guarded equation defines stringSequenceCodes for nonnegative inputs by seeding the code for zero and invoking the sequenceAcc summary from counter one.
